query:
select
id as "ID",
name as "Product name",
insurable as "Insurable",
category as "Category",
source_record_id as "Category ID",
available_facilities as "Available facilities",
visibility_status as "Visibility status",
external_code as "Lab external code"
from "reporting"."ds__invoice_products"
order by name
name: Invoice products summary
notes: This report provides a summary of all invoice products, including their insurable status, category, and pricing across all price lists and insurance plans.
